submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective: the pole fires on a sub-word piece that opens a word, compound or phrase which that piece cannot finish - the first token of a multi-token word (' pr' in pr|un|ings, ' was' in was|abi, ' Sevent' in Sevent|een, ' er' in er|stes, ' cre' in cre|cimiento), the piece just after a hyphen or apostrophe junction inside a compound or name ('back' in cups-backends, 'bug' in pianiste-bugliste, 'of' in internet-of-things, " '" in Kaua'i, '-' in 2971-2975), a non-ASCII byte, or a line break that cuts a phrase in two. It sits at its floor on the continuation pieces that finish those words, on the same letters when the word fits in a single token (' cream', ' honey', ' proteins'), and on line breaks at completed sentence, list or table boundaries; every vocabulary item alone yields the same ~0.18, so the drive is contextual, and it promotes no coherent token set (Jacobian kurtosis 3.0), so it computes a word-boundary condition rather than predicting a token.
